entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A planeswalker from Meletis on Theros, an undefeated javelin champion who wields mirror-trap magic, who enters Starnheim to warn the Valkyries and leads the fight to drive Koma back out.

entities.name: Avtyr
entities.description: A black-winged Valkyrie reaper whom Niko trapped earlier, who accuses Niko before helping and finally saves them from falling.

entities.name: Rytva
entities.description: A dove-gray-winged Valkyrie, Avtyr's counterpart, who supports Niko's plan and carries them in the battle.

entities.name: Thura Sail-Rend
entities.description: A splint-mailed warrior of the Beskir clan feasting in Starnheim, whose saga Birgi told.

entities.name: Gæller No-breath
entities.description: A scarred Omenseeker of the ship Icecutter who feasts in Starnheim.

entities.name: Vígniút
entities.description: A flame-bearded berserker of the Tuskeri feasting in Starnheim.

entities.name: Aggro
entities.description: A large gray cat of Starnheim with polar-light fur that leads Niko to the Valkyries.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The colossal Cosmos Serpent that tears through into Starnheim, born from the interstices of the Cosmos with scales as large as a village.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: The winged beings of Starnheim, in white-winged and black-winged pairs, who gather the dead.

entities.name: Evot
entities.description: A Valkyrie Avtyr addresses.

entities.name: Tove
entities.description: A Valkyrie Avtyr addresses.

entities.name: Gisla
entities.description: A Valkyrie Avtyr addresses.

entities.name: Alsig
entities.description: A Valkyrie Avtyr invokes as an example.

entities.name: Birgi
entities.description: The goddess of storytelling who told Thura's saga to Kannah and Omenseekers.

entities.name: Kjell
entities.description: A Kannah mystic whom Niko remembers.

entities.name: Fynn Snakehunter
entities.description: The Kannah leader whose vision Avtyr dismisses.

entities.name: Orhaft Stoneback
entities.description: The Omenseeker Vedrune with whom Avtyr had to negotiate.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: A Theran god Niko associates with fate used as a cage.

entities.name: Threat
entities.description: The Jutmaw ratcatcher cat that chased Niko's mirrors.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: The newer gods of Kaldheim.

entities.name: Kannah
entities.description: A clan of bear riders.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: A clan of sailors.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The paradise at the top of the World Tree where the honored dead feast with Valkyries.

entities.name: Valkmir
entities.description: The black mirror lake of Starnheim, 'blood and bone' of the Valkyries.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The giant tree linking realms, whose pinnacle houses Starnheim.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: The realm of Kaldheim where Niko joined the Kannah.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A Theran polis, Niko's home.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Niko's home plane.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The Viking plane of nine realms.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Openings between worlds; Niko uses one to herd Koma back out.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Realm collisions, here seen pressing against Starnheim's sky.

events.summary: Niko arrives at Starnheim's docks, enters its warm, welcoming hall, and senses it is home.
Niko joins the feasting dead, meeting Thura Sail-Rend, Gæller No-breath and Vígniút and telling of defying destiny.
Following a cat, Niko enters a hall of Valkyries who dismiss them as a lost visitor.
events.quote: You should return to the feast.

events.summary: Niko delivers the warning that the Cosmos Serpent is coming, and the Valkyries refuse to believe Starnheim can be attacked.
events.quote: the Cosmos Serpent is coming for you.

events.summary: Avtyr arrives and accuses Niko of interrupting a Valkyrie judgement, but Niko reveals the limits of the mirror trap and the Valkyries accept it.
events.quote: You were never in danger from me.

events.summary: Koma tears into the sky above Starnheim from the Cosmos and the Valkyries panic.
events.quote: The creature solidified into a massive, armored eel, born from the interstices of the Cosmos itself.

events.summary: Niko proposes luring Koma like a cat chasing toys back out through an Omenpath; Avtyr and Rytva agree.
events.quote: Fly in close, right side or left side—make it chase you the way cats chase toys.

events.summary: Forty Valkyries take to the air, and Niko lands on Koma's neck to anchor a javelin at its skull.
events.quote: They slid down the last few feet of neck to bury their spear between the scales of Koma's skull.

events.summary: Valkyries bait Koma while Niko's mirror traps hide their bodies, steering Koma along.
events.quote: The serpent's jaws clamped down on nothing but clouds.

events.summary: Niko spots the right Omenpath, an open portal of flame and battle, and directs the last Valkyrie squad to draw Koma toward it.
events.quote: THERE!" Niko shouted, raising their left fist.

events.summary: Koma crashes through the hole and falls out of Starnheim, and Niko is nearly pulled in.
events.quote: Koma's weight and momentum carried it the rest of the way down through the hole

events.summary: Niko lets go, but Avtyr catches them and flies down with them into the battle as Valkyries follow.
events.quote: Avtyr's hand clamped around their wrist.

relations.note: Once captor and captive, they now fight Koma together.
Rytva trusts Niko and carries them into battle.
relations.quote: You see what I see in them, dear one. Don't be stubborn.

relations.note: Rytva is Avtyr's counterpart and dear one.
relations.quote: You see what I see in them, dear one.

relations.note: Koma attacks Starnheim and the Valkyries fight to drive it back.
relations.quote: We have to fight it. We can't let it harm the people.

relations.note: Niko anchors javelins in Koma's skull to steer it.
relations.quote: Niko's power flowed down through the javelin to make an anchor
